answer_1.quote: This work focuses on already identified elaborations in the simplified text, and introduces implicit questions under discussion ("implicit QUD", yellow box) to characterize and help generate the elaborations.

answer_2.quote: We first evaluate generated questions with two automatic measures, BERTScore and BLEU, comparing the generated questions with human annotated questions.

answer_4.quote: Two undergraduate annotators evaluated a random sample of 50 questions generated by these three models along with the human annotated questions, with a total of 200 questions.
answer_4.guideline: annotators judge questions along two criteria: (1) Is the question reasonable to ask given the current context? (2) Is this question answered by the elaboration?
